description:
I came to Yulguk in Wonderland with a friend who said she was a princess in my previous life...Weird. There is an imperial palace in my memory, and seeing the emperor makes my heart pound. 

“I like you a lot."   
“Hey, no, your Majesty. It’s different from just now.”   
"No. I definitely like you, Yulgi. I want and crave you But this heart is ambiguous for love.”

Eventually sparked a debate over who was the actual princess, and we were put to the test. By the way… Oh My God. 

“What is that? What is it, Yulgi-kun?” 

My previous life wasn't a princess, it was the cat that the princess's brother had!
